Definition: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
BiblicalUsage: 1) day, time, year; 1a) day (as opposed to night); 1b) day (24 hour period); 1b1) as defined by evening and morning in Genesis 1; 1b2) as a division of time; 1b2a) a working day, a day's journey; 1c) days, lifetime (pl.); 1d) time, period (general); 1e) year; 1f) temporal references; 1f1) today; 1f2) yesterday; 1f3) tomorrow
